t5_definition.requires: Tracked byte[]/ByteBuffer identity has a FACT edge into at least one of: aget-byte/aget; ByteBuffer.wrap/get*/put*; String([B); or a parse/decode-named invoke that also receives the tracked buffer (dataflow_role).
t5_definition.excludes: InputStream/AccessorySocket read()I or read([B)I *length* move-result (READ_LENGTH); method/class names alone; copy-only without further processing; protocol/message meaning claims.
t5_definition.sees_v13: Transport wrapper read/write; BYTE_ARRAY arg; mis-tagged PRIMITIVE_DECODE from read length; PATH-COMM INBOUND_PRIMITIVE without real byte ops.
t5_definition.cannot_see_v13: Interface consumers (AccessorySocket;->read in BclConnection); Packet.decode* ByteBuffer.getShort/getInt; aget-byte loops; state mutation onto Packet fields after decode.
